subject.title: docs(skills): add backporting to release maintainer

question: Should release-openclaw-maintainer permanently own extended-stable backport discovery and npm-only publication after the selector-repair wording is corrected?
rationale: The code/docs review can identify the wording defect, but accepting the integrated operator process and private-advisory handoff requires release/security owner intent.

options.title: Keep integrated release skill
options.body: Fix the selector-repair wording, then let the release-maintainer skill own extended-stable backport discovery, staging, publication handoff, and recovery.

options.title: Split backporting out
options.body: Keep extended-stable backport discovery in a separate skill if owners want it operationally separate from normal release publishing.

options.title: Pause for policy work
options.body: Keep the PR draft while owners refine the extended-stable repair and advisory workflow outside this branch.

recommendation.title: Keep integrated release skill
recommendation.body: Fix the selector-repair wording, then let the release-maintainer skill own extended-stable backport discovery, staging, publication handoff, and recovery.

likelyOwner.reason: The main unresolved decision is release-operator workflow ownership; secops is adjacent for the advisory-handling portion.
